subject.title: [Bug]: Slash command error——WebUI treats `/model status` as a model name instead of a slash-command subcommand

question: Which canonical fix path should own the remaining Control UI `/model list` and `/model status` bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but same-repo fix attempts are closed and the remaining linked fork PR is conflicting, so automation should not queue another repair until maintainers choose whether to refresh, replace, or close that path.

options.title: Land a fresh narrow fix
options.body: Close or supersede stale/conflicting attempts, then land one current-main patch aligned with docs and shared directive behavior.

options.title: Refresh the linked fork PR
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase and revise the existing fork PR so `list` and `status` use the documented flows and include after-fix proof.

options.title: Wait for contributor follow-up
options.body: Keep the issue open without a new fix lane until an existing contributor returns with a mergeable, proven update.

recommendation.title: Land a fresh narrow fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede stale/conflicting attempts, then land one current-main patch aligned with docs and shared directive behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest recent history on Control UI model-command handling and can choose whether to refresh, replace, or close the linked PR path.
